testo:

Shield Trigger
■ Choose one of your opponent's creatures. That creature gets -8000 power until the end of the turn. (A creature that has power 0 or less is destroyed.)
■ Choose one of your opponent's creatures in the battle zone that has power 8000 or less and return to its owner's hand.
